text:
Maya (CSM): Short kickoff for Orchard Health onboarding. Goal: align stakeholders, confirm data & compliance prereqs, and set 30-day acceptance criteria. Proposed Mon 11:00 PT (15m).
Evan (Orchard PO): Monday 11:00 PT OK. Must include legal on data retention & PHI masking questions.
Hana (Solutions Eng): For integration: need sample payloads (sanitized), sandbox API key, and expected qps. If anyone from Orchard can share a schema that helps.
Evan (Orchard PO): I'll ask infra to export a sample schema + small CSV by EOD Sun.
Ravi (Enablement): I'll schedule a 30-min enablement after the kickoff to demo flows and hand over runbook. Will add a short section on masking verification and audit logging.
Maya (CSM): Draft success criteria to confirm:
- Staging ingest + 2 core flows end-to-end in 30d
- Demo recorded and runbook delivered
- Compliance checklist signed (retention/masking)
- Weekly health digest with 3 signals for renewal tracking
Evan (Orchard PO): For renewal signals, we want: active users hitting flows, error rate, and avg latency.
Hana (Solutions Eng): Noted. Example staging auth snippet I'll use once we have keys:
```bash
export RW_API_KEY=stg-xyz
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}' \
  https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Maya (CSM): Risks up front: delayed sample data, compliance signoff lag, quota surprises. We'll assign mitigations in the kickoff.
OnboardingBot: Calendar event created: "Orchard Health onboarding kickoff" Mon 11:00 PT. Invitees: Maya, Evan, Hana, Ravi.
Maya (CSM): I'll post a 1-pager in the channel 2 hours before and include a short pre-req checklist. Thanks everyone.
